# Compose fixtures: sources and licences

Inputs for the compose engine tests (`test/compose.test.ts`) and the docxcompose differential
test (`scripts/docxcompose-diff/`). Every `.docx` is copied byte for byte from an MIT-licensed
project at a pinned commit; each file was checked against the upstream blob SHA (`git hash-object`).
They are not part of the curated corpus (`test/fixtures/expected.json`); tests reach them with
`fixture()` or by path. Licences: `LICENSE` here (both texts) and one per subfolder.

| Folder | Project | Licence | Pinned commit | Upstream path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docxcompose/` | [4teamwork/docxcompose](https://github.com/4teamwork/docxcompose) | MIT | `b8bac82507786aa350178ad39bfeb9555b3f7429` | `tests/docs/<file>` (every input document except `aatmay.docx`, 900 KB; the `composed_fixture/` outputs are not copied) |
| `powertools/` | [OfficeDev/Open-Xml-PowerTools](https://github.com/OfficeDev/Open-Xml-PowerTools) | MIT | `5881422a881f6ccefce2b9801b5dc6a753670d6e` (branch vNext, archived) | `TestFiles/DB*` (DocumentBuilder tests; `-built` baselines and `DB006-Source2.docx`, 490 KB, not copied) |

Renamed files: PowerTools files from sub-folders are flattened, `/` → `__` and spaces → `_`
(e.g. `TestFiles/DB/HeadersFooters/Dest/Fax (content control).docx` →
`powertools/DB__HeadersFooters__Dest__Fax_(content_control).docx`).
